The district is Manhattan Community Board 9: Morningside Heights, Manhattanville, and Hamilton Heights. The table below is the 2020 census tract list that City Planning assigns to community-district tabulation area MN09, with the Census Bureau's 2023 five-year estimates.

Figure 1 in the PDF is the boundary map. Its geometry was not independently checked, so this site does not redraw it.

Tract 217.03 has a population of 211 and a suppressed median household income. That cell stays blank. The other nineteen medians are the estimates as published, with the margin of error the Bureau publishes beside them.

## Printed identifiers

The PDF uses some tract numbers that are not on this 2020 list, including 209, 213.01, 217.01, 221, 221.01, 222, 223, 227.01, and 231.01. Those identifiers stay in the crosswalk with an empty 2020 id. This site does not guess which current tract each one became.

The printed tract guide, including its incomes, is kept as a transcription on the [reproducibility](reproducibility.qmd) page.
